The tallest is Dominik Olejniczak at 213 cm. The youngest is Dante Maddox Jr. (born 2002) and the most experienced Giulio Gazzotti (born 1991). Beyond Italy, the squad draws most on USA (4), Bosnia and Herzegovina (1) and Cameroon (1). Giulio Gazzotti is back for another spell at the club.
